title: Require Service Router Authorship
forbids: a detached function declaration beside a router handler, operation logic in a router directory index, or a multi-operation semantic group without its purpose, shared capability or guard, behavior, and neighboring relation
why: Router handlers are the operation authoring sites. Keeping transitions in handlers, indexes composition-only, and real semantic groups documented prevents a second hand-built execution layer.
remediate: Author complete handlers in router.ts or named *.router.ts files. Move independent decisions to model policy, subordinate stateless mechanics to model helpers, and outside calls behind context-provided ports. Keep index.ts to imports plus the composed router export. Standalone leaves need no group comment; document each real multi-operation group with @purpose, @capability, @behavior, and @relation.
message: Service router files must retain operation authorship and compose without displaced logic.
